top_signals.title: Colombia Is at Risk of Default Without Fiscal Fix, Restrepo Says
top_signals.summary: Colombia is at risk of default if Congress fails to approve a fiscal adjustment bill, Vice President José Manuel Restrepo said in an interview with local magazine Semana, warning that the country faces a severe economic crisis without the proposed measures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks to Fall on AI Fears, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set for declines, tracking Friday’s sharp Wall Street selloff as a rout in technology shares deepened concerns that a rally in artificial intelligence may have gone too far. Oil fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Australian Far-Right Party Regains Poll Lead as Government Slips
top_signals.summary: Australia’s far-right One Nation party regained the lead in a national opinion poll as support for Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s center-left government slipped against a backdrop of elevated inflation and interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: $3.6B flees Binance on reopen, THORChain co-founder opposes coin freeze: Hodler’s Digest
top_signals.summary: Binance has reopened withdrawals following the world’s biggest ever hack, and THORChain co-founder argues it should not halt the protocol to comply with FBI demands.
